sequential-20.description: Baseline: 20 requests, one per transaction; the next request is sent only after the previous one is fulfilled or expired.

burst-50.description: 50 requests opened by one transaction, so all share one block.

burst-200.description: 200 requests opened by four 50-request transactions broadcast together; about 11M gas each, so they need at least two 30M-gas blocks.

sustained-5rps-40s.description: Sustained arrivals: one 5-request transaction every second for 40 seconds (200 requests). 40 s instead of 60 s keeps the whole suite under 500 paid requests.

smoke.description: Pipeline check before a real run; results go to results/smoke/ and are not published.
